dedupe_keys.name: worlddab factsheet dab digital radio a guide to a successful field trial march 2024

description: This WorldDAB factsheet, dated March 2024, explains how to set up an on-air DAB+ field trial that provides coverage to a target area, as groundwork for a national rollout. It says trials can start with a major city and expand to regions to understand terrain and clutter, or verify the transmission power needed for small-scale DAB, and lists activities: technical workshops, coverage and propagation exploration by mobile drive testing, building entry loss assessment and man-made noise characterisation, laboratory tests of audio quality, stakeholder demonstrations, and operational training on multiplexers, transmitters and test equipment. It also stresses forming a working group of broadcasters and the regulator and points to the free WorldDAB ebook on establishing DAB+. Producer: WorldDAB, the digital radio industry body. Coverage: guidance applicable to any country. Access: a free eight-page PDF. Licence and cost: no licence text read; free. Caveats: a short guidance document with no measurement data. Simulation uses: the listed measurement campaigns (drive tests, building entry loss, man-made noise) define the calibration data needed for coverage models. Related records: the WorldDAB country status data (data-worlddab-country-status-digital-radio) and EBU Tech 3391 (data-ebu-tech-3391-dab-network-planning-guidelines).
